designSummary: Conditional logistic regression on within-site matched sets from three emergency departments.
sampleSize: At 6 percent a year (claim c6), the tertiary ED gives about 189 cases (March 2023 to December 2025) and the two community EDs about 102 (2024 to 2025), about 291 cases in all. With four controls per case and enrolment in about 21 percent of controls, 291 cases give about 82 percent power at two-sided alpha 0.05 for an odds ratio of 0.6, against 62 percent for the tertiary ED alone. Site-specific estimates will be imprecise, especially at the community sites, and are reported as secondary.
primaryAnalysis: Conditional logistic regression on matched sets (matching within site on age band, sex and calendar month) for enrolment before the index date, adjusted for prior-year visits, comorbidity index, mental health diagnosis, housing instability and family doctor attachment.
secondaryAnalysis: Odds ratios by time since enrolment; death alone as a component; site-specific odds ratios with a test of heterogeneity; estimates by family doctor attachment and housing status; contact count as a secondary exposure.
missingData: Unavailable files are reported by site; missing housing status is handled by multiple imputation with 20 imputations; a sensitivity analysis excludes matched sets with any unavailable file.
multiplicity: One primary association; secondary and site-specific estimates reported with intervals and labelled as secondary.
software: R with the survival package; analysis plan filed with the ethics board before abstraction.
overfittingGuards: Five adjustment covariates fixed before abstraction
summary: About 291 cases across three sites give about 82 percent power for an odds ratio of 0.6; site estimates are secondary.
